asserted_claims: Conditional relative Fock cutoff and finite adaptive complete readout with joint confidence for 272 acquisitions.
Explicit sufficient shot bounds for the specified uniform-cutoff Hadamard experiment; no universal lower bound or physical implementation claim.
difference: Unlike the prior dominant/selfcalibrated decoder, this theorem explicitly turns a specified whole-word contraction oracle into complete measured outcomes, accounts for the relative Fock cutoff and unknown-mean stopping costs. Half-form scale cancels only from the relative cutoff, remains in the measurement signal and sample costs. Prior CIRCULAR/LOSSY_CONSTANT CP-to-Weil routes are not revived: no positive CP structure is substituted for a signed Weil form; an entire oriented source is conditionally reconstructed.
method: General trace-class tail proof, explicit complete unitary block construction and Hadamard outcome law, confidence sequence by countable Hoeffding union, exact adaptive resource inequalities and source-word/filter controls.
next_test: Derive from the allowed native marked alphabet a phasically calibrated coherent implementation of the complete word VK with correct half-form factor and all boundaries/outcomes retained, plus state preparation and an error/cost proof. Reject composing same-ancilla letter dilations as if their upper blocks multiplied.
object: For each g in GL2(H_Q), ||g^-1||<=3, positive word h=R^k U_j (4<=k<=19), set B=(hg)^-1, A=sqrt(Nrd g), c=(4^k A)^-1 and S=c C_B on four-mode Bargmann Fock space. Let dK=binom(K+4,4), LK=sum(n>K)binom(n+3,3)(3/4)^n. Prove relative trace tail <=(7/4)^4 LK. For a coherently controlled complete Halmos dilation VK of S restricted to grades<=K, a uniform cutoff state and two ancillas give +/-1 outcomes with mean ReTr(SPK)/dK. With M=272, b=ceil(log2(M/beta)), n_r=2^r, a_r^2=2(r+b+2)/2^r and theta=epsilon/2, stop at positive mean estimate and (1+theta)^2 a_r^2<=theta^2 mean^2. Tail<=epsilon/4 gives relative trace error<=7epsilon/8, and the existing two-stage decoder recovers g at requested relative Frobenius tolerance with joint confidence>=1-beta.
obligations: Native whole-word controlled-dilation realization with relative phase, source preparation and complete boundary/memory preservation.
Physical implementation errors must be included in the adaptive stopping analysis; final additive rounding reserve alone is not such an analysis.
Full separate all-place Weil/Gamma/pole identity and global signed positivity.
scope: Conditional source-operator-to-data theorem on the fixed quaternionic inverse-norm-bounded Fock source class. Whole-word coherent controlled-dilation access, relative phase, uniform cutoff preparation, fresh independent shots and exact postprocessing are additional resources. No native compiler, Wold-boundary intertwiner, log-norm time identification, physical gate precision or efficient complexity is established.
stop_condition: Stop at the conditional Fock operator-access experiment. Do not infer native implementation from algebraic Halmos square roots, ignore small signal costs, treat trace as success probability, infer all-place/RH positivity, or convert relative bit counts into physical sample complexity.
